target.title: fix(memory): backfill provider.model with resolved model name
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When a memory embedding adapter returns an empty `provider.model` (because the user did not explicitly configure a model, leaving it to `adapter.defaultModel`), the downstream memory identity, `providerKey`, chunk model tags, and vector search filters all see `""` instead of the resolved model name. This causes persistent `Dirty` index state and broken vector search (`WHERE c.model = ''` returns zero rows), reported as issue #90042.

## Why This Change Was Made

The `createWithAdapter` function already resolves the model via `resolveProviderModel(adapter, options.model)` and passes it into `adapter.create(...)`. But the returned `result.provider.model` can be empty if the adapter itself returns an empty string — the resolved model is discarded after `create` returnscars, leaving downstream consumers with no fallback.

The fix is a single-line backfill at the return site: `result.provider.model || resolvedModel`. This is a *runtime backfill*, not a persisted-data migration.

## Behavior Matrix

| Scenario | result.provider.model | adapter.defaultModel (resolvedModel) | Before | After | Changed? |
|----------|----------------------|--------------------------------------|--------|-------|----------|
| User explicitly sets model | `"qwen3-8b"` | irrelevant | `"qwen3-8b"` | `"qwen3-8b"` (short-circuit `\|\|`) | ❌ No |
| User leaves empty, adapter has default | `""` | `"text-embedding-3-small"` | `""` (bug) | `"text-embedding-3-small"` | ✅ Fix |
| User leaves empty, adapter has no default | `""` | `""` | `""` | `""` (`"" \|\| ""` = `""`) | ❌ No |
| User leaves empty, provider returns correct model | `"ada-002"` | irrelevant | `"ada-002"` | `"ada-002"` (short-circuit `\|\|`) | ❌ No |

Only scenario 2 changes, which is the exact bug from issue #90042.

## User Impact

Transparent for correct configurations (scenarios 1, 3, 4 — zero change). Users who saw a persistent `Dirty` index due to an empty `provider.model` will find their vector search working again after upgrade. No migration or reindex needed.

## Real Behavior Proof

**Real environment tested**: Linux x86_64, Node v24.13.1, upstream/main

**Exact steps or command run after this patch**:

```bash
node --import tsx --input-type=module -e "
import { createEmbeddingProvider } from './extensions/memory-core/src/memory/embeddings.ts';

// Scenario 1: Explicit model + live embedding via ZTE MaaS endpoint
const r1 = await createEmbeddingProvider({
  provider: 'openai-compatible',
  model: 'Qwen3-Embedding-8B',
  config: { models: { providers: { 'openai-compatible': { api: 'openai', baseUrl: '<redacted>', apiKey: '<redacted>' } } } },
  remote: { baseUrl: '<redacted>', apiKey: '<redacted>' },
});
console.log('Explicit model provider.model:', JSON.stringify(r1.provider?.model));
const vec = await r1.provider?.embedQuery?.('hello world');
console.log('embedQuery dims:', vec?.length);

// Scenario 2: No explicit model — backfill from adapter.defaultModel
const r2 = await createEmbeddingProvider({
  provider: 'openai',
  model: '',
  config: { models: { providers: { openai: { api: 'openai', baseUrl: '<redacted>', apiKey: '<redacted>' } } } },
  remote: { baseUrl: '<redacted>', apiKey: '<redacted>' },
});
console.log('Empty model provider.model (backfilled):', JSON.stringify(r2.provider?.model));
"
```

**Evidence after fix**:

```
Explicit model provider.model: "Qwen3-Embedding-8B"
embedQuery dims: 4096
Empty model provider.model (backfilled): "text-embedding-3-small"
```

**Observed result after fix**: Explicit model → `provider.model` matches. Empty model → `provider.model` backfilled from `adapter.defaultModel` (`"text-embedding-3-small"`). On upstream/main (without this patch), scenario 2 returns `""`.

**What was not tested**: Full `openclaw memory index --force` reindex through the gateway (requires full workspace setup). The proof covers the production `createEmbeddingProvider` → `embedQuery` code path with a real embedding endpoint, which is the exact code path changed by this PR.

Supersedes #91660 (31 days old, merge conflicts, larger diff with unrelated deletions). This branch is based on latest upstream/main with a focused +5/-2 diff.
